verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS security and compliance platform that stores customer workspace data, so letting customers choose a storage region is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location. Workspace selection, scoped service keys and RBAC are different controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
